goal: A Google-aligned sitemap architecture whose exact per-file contents and health are visible in the authenticated VII administration system.

intent_model.literal_request: Research whether the vacations sitemap page is too long and show what every sitemap file contains in admin.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Adir can understand and operate the complete sitemap estate without reading XML source or guessing whether Google limits are being approached.
likely_rejections: The result is not visible in admin

interpretation_rules.phrase: כל קובץ מפת אתר של כל נושא
interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory every generated sitemap child file across all sections.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: The index and admin file list must reconcile exactly.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Overall sitemap health and family totals.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Which family or file needs inspection.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Expand a family and open the exact XML or inspect its samples and composition.
deferred_complexity: Raw URL-by-URL export remains behind the XML link

natural_destination: Authenticated /admin/growth and public XML sitemap endpoints.

facts.claim: Google limits one sitemap to 50,000 URLs or 50MB uncompressed.
facts.evidence: Google Search Central official sitemap documentation

facts.claim: The live vacations file currently contains 2,420 URL entries and 3,922,972 UTF-8 bytes.

assumptions.claim: Existing 10,000 URL chunking remains safely below the byte limit for current content density.
assumptions.validation: Calculate rendered byte size for every generated file and expose warning thresholds.

in_scope: Protected per-family and per-file admin diagnostics
out_of_scope: Changing indexability decisions or public URLs without evidence
invariants: Only canonical indexable URLs remain included
Four locale editions and reciprocal hreflang remain intact
Admin API stays restricted to approved admins

requirements.statement: Measure and classify every generated sitemap file against Google limits.
requirements.source: User request and Google Search Central

requirements.statement: Show each family and child file in admin with its composition and direct link.
Preserve authentication, current public sitemap behavior and approved Hebrew typography.

acceptance_checks.observable_result: Counts and bytes match rendered XML and every file is below 50,000 URLs and 50MB.
Every indexed child file shows URL count, size, languages, images, content types, samples and an open link.
The API returns 403 and no inventory.
A clear Hebrew error and retry action are shown without exposing stale success data.

authorization_boundary: Local implementation and verification are authorized; production publication remains subject to current release authorization and exact post-deploy verification.
